description: Apply the exact, unexpired quote the user explicitly approved after seeing its immediate charges, recurring price, effective time and limits. May charge a saved payment method, change the subscription, cancel renewal or undo a scheduled change. Set user_authorized=true only after that approval; never infer permission to spend. Reuse the same request_id and arguments after a lost response. Return any payment/authentication URL for the user to complete; never collect payment credentials in chat.

user_authorized.description: The user explicitly approved this quote's charges and terms. Never infer approval from a request to preview.

name: execute_subscription_change
